defs.def: a serious disease in which growths of cells, also called cancers, form in the body and kill normal body cells. The disease often causes death. 癌；癌症

ex.s: On most UK high streets, for example, you will often come across people raising money and looking for volunteers for Cancer Research UK, the British Heart Foundation, the Royal National Lifeboat Institution and many more.
ex.t: 例如，在英国大多数商业街上，你常会遇到为英国癌症研究中心、英国心脏基金会、皇家全国救生艇协会等机构募款和招募志愿者的人。

ex.s: At age 12, Jane was diagnosed with a rare and deadly cancer, and was informed that high-risk surgery was her only chance of getting better.
ex.t: 12岁时，简被诊断出患有一种罕见而致命的癌症，并被告知高风险手术是她好转的唯一机会。

ex.s: She is determined to live a fulfilling life regardless of what the future holds, and to try her best to help patients with this cancer recover in spite of the various difficulties she might face.
ex.t: 她决心无论未来如何都要活得充实，并尽力帮助患这种癌症的病人康复，尽管可能面临各种困难。

ex.s: I think it’s also fair to say that we can get our hopes up when it comes to finding cures for serious diseases, such as cancer.
ex.t: 我认为也可以公正地说，当谈到为癌症等严重疾病寻找治疗方法时，我们可能会抱有过高的期望。

ex.s: They can warn you early on if there is something abnormal or if you have a critical illness, such as cancer, and potentially save your life.
ex.t: 如果出现异常情况，或者你患上了癌症等严重疾病，它们可以提前警告你，并有可能挽救你的生命。

defs.def: an evil or dangerous thing that spreads quickly （迅速蔓延的）邪恶；（社会）毒瘤
